name: Active Noise Control
description: Acoustic wave equation; plane and spherical waves; reflection and transmission; passive control measures and their limitations; Fourier series; Fourier integral; Laplace transform; optimal filtering; z-transform; FIR and IIR filters; active control in 1D ducts; mechanisms of cancellation; single channel feedforward control of sound; LMS algorithm; reference signals; FxLMS algorithm; identification of secondary paths; active control of free field sound radiation; single channel feedback control; global control of enclosed 3D sound fields; local control of enclosed 3D sound fields; Multichannel feedforward control; applications of active noise control; active headsets; automotive and aerospace applications implementation of an experimental active noise control system; active control of sound in vibro-acoustic cavities; active structural-acoustic control (ASAC).
